answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that must co-sign audited work with several already-established peers drawn from SEPARATE funding clusters. Standing then accretes glacier-slow across many epochs. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements only echo back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters; its reputation stays frozen while a lone honest node earns steady saffron-bright trust. Forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors and 100 slow climbs, versus honest once.
